_meta.description: English-query diagnostic twin of data/qrels.json. The field question_ru holds an English translation of each question; relevance is identical, so RU vs EN results measure the cross-lingual retrieval gap for the same information need.
_meta.mapping_rule: Same as data/qrels.json: a chunk is relevant if its section_ids intersect relevant_sections.

questions.question_ru: What was the primary purpose of the Apollo 11 mission and how were the roles distributed among the crew members?
Why did the crew reject the initial landing site and switch to manual control during the landing?
Why was the surface EVA scheduled before the first planned rest period?
Why did preparation for the surface EVA take longer than the training had suggested?
How did lunar dust hinder equipment transfer and the use of the television cable?
What problems prevented the crew from sleeping well in the lunar module?
Why was the splashdown area changed and how did it affect the atmospheric entry program?
How did the passive seismic experiment perform during the first two weeks despite the temperature?
Where relative to the lunar module was the laser retro-reflector deployed?
For what scientific purposes was the laser ranging intended and what accuracy was required?
How were the solar wind particles collected and how long was the foil exposed?
How did the estimated crew energy expenditure during the EVA compare with the preflight estimates?
What two responsibilities did the lunar sample program serve and why was quarantine planned?
How were the cabins cleaned of lunar dust before transfer to the command module and on the return trip?
What caused the computer overload alarms during descent and did they disrupt the guidance?
